title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #15 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these shows tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   B. Blaming luck
   C. Doing nothing and hoping
   D. Ignoring safety

2. Which of these is a manner of dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ask with humility and hope
   B. Shout
   C. Demand
   D. Give up quickly

3. What does the dua for entering the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. Say He is Allah
   B. Read in the name
   C. Guide us
   D. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend

4. What should we say to family after entering? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Hello only
   C. As-salamu alaykum
   D. Goodbye

5. Who is a shepherd responsible for his flock according to the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Only kings
   B. Only traders
   C. Every person responsible for those in his care
   D. Only teachers

6. Why are children called an amanah? (1 mark)
   A. They are a trust from Allah
   B. They are property
   C. They are strangers
   D. They are servants

7. Who deserves the best company according to the hadith, asked three times? (1 mark)
   A. Your friend
   B. Your teacher
   C. Your neighbour
   D. Your mother

8. What does "Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira" mean? (1 mark)
   A. My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   B. Say He is Allah
   C. Praise Allah
   D. Guide us to the straight path

9. What is the extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Only friends
   B. Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   C. Only parents
   D. Only neighbours

10. Which action helps keep family ties? (1 mark)
   A. Envy
   B. Gossiping
   C. Avoiding
   D. Visiting relatives

11. Which family event should we attend to keep ties? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only cartoons
   C. A wedding or naming ceremony
   D. Only sad events

12. What was the first word revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Give
   B. Iqra (Read)
   C. Pray
   D. Fast

13. What does the command "Iqra" teach us? (1 mark)
   A. Seek knowledge
   B. Stay silent
   C. Avoid books
   D. Only pray

14. What did Abu Bakr do with his wealth? (1 mark)
   A. Wasted it
   B. Freed believers and supported Islam
   C. Hid it
   D. Refused to give

15. How can we honour the early converts? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   C. Insult them
   D. Forget them

16. What did Khadija notice about Muhammad? (1 mark)
   A. His honesty and trustworthiness
   B. His wealth
   C. His height
   D. His speed

17. What does "convert" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A traveller
   B. A trader
   C. A person who accepts a new faith
   D. A teacher

18. What did the angel of the mountains offer? (1 mark)
   A. To crush the people between two mountains
   B. To carry him
   C. To bring food
   D. To bring rain

19. Which virtue is needed if a classmate teases you? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Patience and tolerance
   C. Revenge
   D. Shouting

20. What happened to Taif later? (1 mark)
   A. It disappeared
   B. Its people accepted Islam in later years
   C. It never changed
   D. It was destroyed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain why keeping family ties is important. (4 marks)

22. State three ways Khadija (R.A.) helped the Prophet (S.A.W.). (3 marks)

23. Explain the hadith about keeping family ties and provision. (3 marks)

24. State three benefits of saying the duas for leaving and entering the house. (3 marks)

25. Why was the Prophet (S.A.W.) called Al-Amin? (3 marks)

26. Draw or describe a simple family chart showing at least five relatives and their Kiswahili names. (5 marks)

27. Explain why the earliest converts are important. (3 marks)

28. How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)? (3 marks)

29. Explain the difference between patience and revenge with a school example. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   Do your part and trust Allah.

2. A — Ask with humility and hope
   Dua is humble.

3. D — In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend
   That is the meaning.

4. C — As-salamu alaykum
   Greet with salaam.

5. C — Every person responsible for those in his care
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

6. A — They are a trust from Allah
   Parents must care for them.

7. D — Your mother
   Then the father on the fourth time.

8. A — My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small
   That is the meaning.

9. B — Relatives beyond parents and siblings
   Grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins.

10. D — Visiting relatives
   Visits strengthen bonds.

11. C — A wedding or naming ceremony
   Attending strengthens ties.

12. B — Iqra (Read)
   Iqra means read.

13. A — Seek knowledge
   Islam values knowledge.

14. B — Freed believers and supported Islam
   He bought and freed people.

15. B — Learn their stories and copy their qualities
   Imitate their good deeds.

16. A — His honesty and trustworthiness
   That is why she respected him.

17. C — A person who accepts a new faith
   A convert changes beliefs.

18. A — To crush the people between two mountains
   The Prophet refused.

19. B — Patience and tolerance
   Stay calm.

20. B — Its people accepted Islam in later years
   A delegation later accepted Islam.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is Allah's command, it brings love, unity and support, brings blessing and is an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was first to believe, comforted him, supported him with wealth, stayed with him in hardship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Whoever wants his provision increased and life extended should keep good relations with relatives. Family ties bring blessing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the two rewards, 1 mark for blessing.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, remembering Allah, blessings and peace, following the Sunnah, building good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: People trusted him with their valuables because he was honest and returned them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for keeping trust.

26. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: babu, bibi, baba, shangazi, mjomba, binamu, each placed correctly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct relative up to 5.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: They believed when it was hard, supported the Prophet morally and materially, and encouraged others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience is staying calm and trusting Allah, while revenge is hurting back. If a classmate teases you, you stay calm and tell a teacher instead of fighting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for patience, 1 mark for revenge, 1 mark for example.
